name: scripe
description: Plan, write, schedule and measure your team's LinkedIn posts in Scripe from your AI agent: content calendars for every profile and company page, posts in each person's voice, scheduling and LinkedIn analytics, through the hosted Scripe MCP server (OAuth, no install).

scripe.note: Official Scripe MCP server (hosted, Streamable HTTP). Signs in with OAuth on first connection; no token or local install.
